sources.title: Gemeinde Dummerstorf: Satzung über die 1. Änderung des Bebauungsplanes Nr. 25b „Gewerbe- und Logistikzentrum Ostsee 3.0“ – Bekanntmachung der frühzeitigen Öffentlichkeitsbeteiligung (official notice of 14 October 2026, with Übersichtsplan)
sources.license: official municipal notice; map extract © GeoBasis-DE/MV 2026
sources.summary: The Gemeinde Dummerstorf's official notice states that the aim of the 1st amendment of Bebauungsplan Nr. 25b „Gewerbe- und Logistikzentrum Ostsee 3.0“ is to create the concrete settlement conditions for a large data centre (Giga-Factory), which would need almost all of the plan area, so that additional public planned roads become unnecessary and are to be dropped; adjustments to the permitted degree of building use and the landscaping rules are also needed. The Gemeindevertretung approved the preliminary draft (Vorentwurf) of the amendment on 22 September 2026; the preliminary draft and its justification are on public display from 29 October to 30 November 2026 (early public participation under § 3 (1) BauGB) in the town hall and on dummerstorf.de and the state planning portal bauportal-mv.de. The annex (Übersichtsplan, an extract of the official topographic map © GeoBasis-DE/MV 2026) outlines the 'Geltungsbereich der 1. Änderung' north-west of Dummerstorf village, west of the existing logistics buildings and south of the A20, and separately marks the larger 'Geltungsbereich Ursprungsplan'. The notice names no developer, operator or capacity and is signed by the mayor. It is a planning step only: no building permit, Federal Immission Control Act permit or physical work is stated.
sources.date_semantics: The notice PDF itself is undated; the Gemeinde's notice page and its notice list date it 'Amtliche Bekanntmachung vom 14.10.2026' (captured with it). 14 October 2026 is used as publication date and status observation (announced). 22 September 2026 is the council decision on the preliminary draft; 29 October-30 November 2026 is a future participation period, not an observation.

sources.title: Gemeinde Dummerstorf: list of official notices (Bekanntmachungen, last six months), captured 27 October 2026
sources.summary: The Gemeinde's list of official notices shows, for October 2026, two items dated 14.10.2026: the Aufstellungsbeschluss for B-Plan Nr. 38 'Wohngebiet am Pankelower Weg' and the early public participation for the 1st amendment of B-Plan Nr. 25b 'Gewerbe- und Logistikzentrum Ostsee 3.0'; the other notices since June 2026 concern elections, a Landtag election, a road-building tender, water-protection zones, the regional plan and the Aufstellung of B-Plan Nr. 37 'Gewerbegebiet Landweg' in Kavelstorf (whose notice describes additional commercial land on an already sealed site and names no data centre). No later notice on B-Plan 25b is listed.

sources.title: Gemeinde Dummerstorf: Begründung zum Bebauungsplan Nr. 25b „Gewerbe- und Logistikzentrum Ostsee 3.0“ (Satzungsbeschluss 1 February 2022)
sources.summary: The justification of the in-force B-Plan Nr. 25b, the third construction stage of the 'Industrie- und Gewerbepark Autobahnkreuz Rostock (Dummerstorf)', describes a plan area of about 46.5 ha south of the A20 and north-west of Dummerstorf village, bounded to the north-east and east by B-Plan Nr. 25a, to the north and west by the Liepgraben lowland and to the south by the Landesstraße 191, zoned as commercial areas (GE/GEe) with internal planned roads. It predates the data-centre plan and names no data centre.
sources.date_semantics: The cover gives Satzungsbeschluss 01.02.2022; publication date unknown. Location and plan-area context only; not a status source.

sources.title: Schwarz Gruppe: Geplante Milliarden-Investition in Infrastruktur und Digitalisierung: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern und Unternehmen der Schwarz Gruppe schließen wegweisende Partnerschaft (press release, Schwerin, 27 August 2026)
sources.summary: The Schwarz Gruppe press release (Schwerin, 27 August 2026) announces a partnership with the state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern including a data-centre infrastructure project: subject to the usual permits the data centre is to have a capacity of 240 MW by 2033 (about EUR 5.6 billion), with prospects of a 1 GW grid connection by 2045, for the companies' own ecosystem and Schwarz Digits. It states that the plot currently in prospect for the data centre lies in the Gewerbegebiet of the Gemeinde Dummerstorf, that a connection to the 380 kV grid is possible at the intended site, that a letter of intent with Stadtwerke Rostock covers waste-heat use, and that the Dummerstorf project is at an early stage with technical specifications not finalised. It names no plan, plot, parcel or Bebauungsplan.
sources.date_semantics: datePublished 2026-08-27 and dateline 'Schwerin, 27. August 2026'. Identity context only for the Dummerstorf record: it does not name B-Plan Nr. 25b or the plot, so it is not used for the locator, status or a role.

sources.title: Internet Archive copy (12 October 2026) of Green Mountain: FRA-Mainz data-centre page
sources.attribution: Green Mountain, greenmountain.no; copy held by the Internet Archive
sources.summary: Green Mountain's FRA-Mainz page, in the Internet Archive's raw copy captured on 12 October 2026, describes FRA-Mainz as a 'New sustainable data center under construction near Frankfurt', lists it in the site menu as 'FRA-Mainz Frankfurt region · Under construction' and states that 'Green Mountain operates five data centers, plus one under construction'. It describes the joint venture with the German power company KMW to build a 54 MW data-centre site with three buildings, 18,000 m2 IT space and 25,000 m2 site space, cooled with Rhine water and supplied by gas turbines from the KMW campus for emergency power, and gives 'Start of construction: Q3 2023' and 'Ready for service: Q4 2026'. No completion, commissioning or operation is stated.
sources.date_semantics: The page shows no visible date; its structured data give dateModified 2026-10-06T10:50:58Z. This is the raw (id_) Internet Archive copy captured 2026-10-12T14:12:33Z, the only copy after 7 June 2026 in the CDX listing captured on 27 October 2026 (local wayback-cdx-greenmountain-fra-mainz-2026.json); the earlier copy of 7 June 2026 carries dateModified 2026-04-20 and different introductory wording, so the 6 October revision is bounded by the two archived copies. The capture is the dated record that the operator's present-tense under-construction statement was published on 12 October 2026, which is source_observation_date. Q3 2023 is the historical construction start and Q4 2026 a forecast; neither is used as a status date.
